source: made up: indie musician with a 9 PM club gig doing rehearsal and gear prep during the day
persona: eli, a bass player and synth programmer in an indie-electronic band playing a headline club show tonight (load-in at 19:30, set at 21:00). Texts casually in all lowercase, protective of vocal and ear rest before a show, and meticulous about cabling and backup gear.
situation: Friday morning waking at 10:00. Band soundcheck/run-through at the rehearsal space is 13:00–15:00, load-in at The Velvet Room is 19:30, and in between eli needs to solder a patchy pedalboard cable, restring the P-bass, print setlists, and eat a solid early dinner.
life: 10:10 wake up and text the app: gig day! rehearsal run-through is 13:00–15:00 (need 30m drive each way) and club load-in is 19:30. help me plan the day: coffee/breakfast, restring my p-bass, fix the patchy trs cable on my pedalboard, print 6 setlists & stage plots at fedex, grab lunch before rehearsal, and eat a real dinner around 17:30 before resting my ears.

10:15 if the app schedules restringing the bass and fixing the pedalboard after rehearsal, remind it that both have to be done before leaving for rehearsal at 12:30 so we can test them at full volume.
10:20 make pour-over coffee and scrambled eggs, eating until 11:00.
11:02 report coffee and breakfast done. putting new flatwound strings on the p-bass and stretching/tuning them now.
11:05 restring the p-bass, clean the fretboard, and check intonation until 11:45.
11:48 report bass restrung. heating up the soldering iron to resolder the loose trs jack on the synth pedalboard.
11:50 resolder the trs patch cable, velcro the power supply, and pack the gig bag and pedalboard case until 12:25.
12:26 text the app: pedalboard fixed and gear packed! didn't have time for a real lunch—grabbing a protein bar in the car and heading to the rehearsal studio now.
12:30 drive to the rehearsal studio and run through the 45-minute setlist with the band from 13:00 to 15:20 (drummer wanted to re-work the transition into the last song).

15:50 get back from rehearsal (stopped at the taco truck outside the studio with the band at 15:20 for late lunch). text the app: rehearsal went until 15:20 and we grabbed tacos right after, just walked in the door. still need to print the 6 large-font setlists at fedex, iron my black stage shirt, and rest before 17:30 dinner.
16:00 walk 10 minutes to FedEx Office, print 6 copies of the setlist and stage plot on cardstock, buy a roll of white gaffer tape, and walk back by 16:40.
16:42 report setlists printed and gaffer tape acquired. ironing stage shirt and packing the cable trunk now.
16:45 iron black button-down shirt, pack extra 9V batteries and earplugs, and stage all cases by the front door until 17:15.
17:18 report gear staged by the door and shirt ironed. lying down in a quiet room for 30 minutes to rest ears before dinner.
17:50 heat up roasted sweet potatoes, salmon, and rice for pre-gig dinner until 18:35.
18:40 report dinner done. take a quick shower and get dressed for the show until 19:15.
19:18 tell the app you're loading the hatchback now to head to The Velvet Room for 19:30 load-in.
19:30 load into the venue, soundcheck at 20:00, play the 21:00–22:00 set, and load gear out after the headliner finishes at 23:30.
constraints: Bass restringing and pedalboard soldering must be completed before leaving for the 13:00 band rehearsal at 12:30.
Rehearsal studio requires a 30-minute drive each way.
Needs at least 30 minutes of quiet ear rest in the late afternoon and a proper meal around 17:30–18:00 before the 19:30 venue load-in.
